# telnyx_mobile_push_credential (Resource)

Credentials for sending push notifications to iOS (APNs) or Android (FCM) apps that use the WebRTC SDKs.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `type` (String) Type of mobile push credential. Either <code>ios</code> or <code>android</code> One of `android`, `ios`.

### Optional

- `alias` (String) Alias to uniquely identify a credential
- `certificate` (String, Sensitive) Apple certificate for sending push notifications. For iOS only
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) Apple private key for a given certificate for sending push notifications. For iOS only
- `project_account_json_file` (String, Sensitive) Google server key for sending push notifications. For Android only A JSON document; use `jsonencode()`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp when the room was created
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of a push credential
- `record_type` (String)
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp when the room was updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_mobile_push_credential.example <id>
```
